mapper.sql: CONCAT(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 'execution:' ELSE 'run:' END, COALESCE(r.id, e.id)) AS group_key, TRIM(CAST(r.id AS CHAR(32))) AS run_id, e.id AS execution_db_id, COALESCE(e.execution_key, CONCAT('run:', r.id, ':', s.id)) AS execution_key, s.id AS scene_db_id, s.scene_id AS scene_key, s.name AS scene_name, COALESCE(rs.scene_order, 0) AS scene_order, e.batch_id, 'debug' AS record_source, COALESCE(e.execution_engine, r.execution_engine) AS execution_engine, COALESCE(e.status, rs.status) AS status, COALESCE(e.result, CASE WHEN rs.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN rs.status ELSE 'pending' END) AS result, COALESCE(e.execute_user_id, r.execute_user_id) AS execute_user_id, COALESCE(e.execute_name, r.execute_name) AS execute_name, COALESCE(e.project_environment_id, r.project_environment_id) AS project_environment_id, e.project_environment_name, COALESCE(e.case_total, 0) AS case_total, COALESCE(e.case_pass, 0) AS case_pass, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cc.status IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') OR cc.execute_status IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') OR cc.execute_result IN ('passed', 'success', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', '14', '15', '16', '17') OR cc.result IN ('passed', 'success', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', '14', '15', '16', '17') THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cc.case_id, ''), NULLIF(cc.case_key, ''), CONCAT('execution-case:', cc.id)) ELSE NULL END) FROM automation_ui_execution_case cc WHERE cc.execution_id = e.id) AS case_completed, COALESCE(e.case_fail, 0) AS case_fail, COALESCE(e.case_skip, 0) AS case_skip, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cb.execute_status = 'blocked' OR cb.status = 'blocked' OR cb.execute_result = 'blocked' OR cb.result = 'blocked' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(cb.case_id, ''), NULLIF(cb.case_key, ''), CONCAT('execution-case:', cb.id)) ELSE NULL END) FROM automation_ui_execution_case cb WHERE cb.execution_id = e.id) AS case_blocked, COALESCE(e.case_cancelled, 0) AS case_cancelled, COALESCE(e.step_total, 0) AS step_total, COALESCE(e.step_pass, 0) AS step_pass, COALESCE(e.step_fail, 0) AS step_fail, COALESCE(e.step_skip, 0) AS step_skip, e.started_at, COALESCE(e.finished_at, CASE WHEN rs.status IN ('cancelled', 'failed') THEN r.finished_at END) AS finished_at, COALESCE(NULLIF(e.duration_ms, 0), TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, e.started_at, e.finished_at) / 1000, 0) AS duration_ms, COALESCE(r.create_time, e.create_time) AS create_time, COALESCE(e.update_time, r.finished_at, r.create_time) AS update_time

WITH history_members AS ( SELECT FROM automation_ui_execution_run_scene rs JOIN automation_ui_execution_run r ON r.id = rs.run_id JOIN automation_ui_scene s ON s.id = rs.scene_id AND s.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_config p ON p.id = s.project_id AND p.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_version_config pv ON pv.id = s.version_id AND pv.project_id = s.project_id AND pv.del_flag = 3 JOIN project_module_config pm ON pm.id = s.module_id AND pm.project_id = s.project_id AND pm.version_id = s.version_id AND pm.del_flag = 3 LEFT JOIN automation_ui_execution e ON e.scene_id = rs.scene_id AND e.batch_id = rs.batch_id WHERE 1 = 1
UNION ALL SELECT FROM automation_ui_execution e
LEFT JOIN automation_ui_execution_run_scene rs ON rs.scene_id = e.scene_id AND rs.batch_id = e.batch_id LEFT JOIN automation_ui_execution_run r ON r.id = rs.run_id WHERE rs.run_id IS NULL
)
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(run_id) AS run_id, CASE WHEN MAX(run_id) IS NULL THEN MAX(execution_db_id) END AS execution_db_id, group_key AS execution_key, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(scene_db_id) END AS scene_db_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(scene_key) END AS scene_key, COALESCE(MAX(run_id), MAX(batch_id)) AS batch_id, 'debug' AS record_source, MAX(execution_engine) AS execution_engine, MAX(execute_user_id) AS execute_user_id, MAX(execute_name) AS execute_name, MAX(project_environment_id) AS project_environment_id, COUNT(*) AS scene_total, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_completed, SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('passed', 'success', '14') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_pass, SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('failed', '15') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_fail, SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('cancelled', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_blocked, SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('skipped', '16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scene_skip, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('queued', 'waiting', 'not_started', '10') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'queued' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'running' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('cancelled', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'completed' END AS status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'pending' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('cancelled', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'cancelled' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('failed', '15') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'failed' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'blocked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'blocked' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('skipped', '16') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'skipped' ELSE 'passed' END AS result, SUM(case_total) AS case_total, SUM(case_pass) AS case_pass, SUM(case_fail) AS case_fail, SUM(case_completed) AS case_completed, SUM(case_blocked) AS case_blocked, SUM(case_skip) AS case_skip, SUM(case_cancelled) AS case_cancelled, SUM(step_total) AS step_total, SUM(step_pass) AS step_pass, SUM(step_fail) AS step_fail, SUM(step_skip) AS step_skip, COALESCE(MIN(started_at), MIN(create_time)) AS started_at, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status NOT IN ('completed', 'passed', 'failed', 'blocked', 'skipped', 'cancelled', 'interrupted', '12', '17') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN MAX(finished_at) END AS finished_at, SUM(duration_ms) AS duration_ms, MIN(create_time) AS create_time, MAX(update_time) AS update_time FROM history_members GROUP BY group_key ORDER BY MIN(create_time) DESC, group_key DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM history_members WHERE run_id = #{runId}
